news.title: 1 arrested after workers restrained in Clayton County $15K pharmacy robbery
news.summary: Police have arrested one suspect after a group of armed robbers allegedly took off with roughly $15,000 in cash and prescription drugs at a Tara Boulevard pharmacy last week.

news.title: Mother demands stiffest punishment for man accused of killing her daughter
news.summary: Erika Harris seeks justice for her daughter after surveillance video showed Torodd Woods allegedly shooting her in Atlanta.

news.title: Atlanta leaders, community mourns 99-year-old educator killed in fire
news.summary: City leaders and neighbors are mourning 99-year-old Phyllis Lawhorn, a trailblazing educator and community historian who died Tuesday morning in a fire at her northwest Atlanta home.

news.title: 2 arrested months after teen killed in Jonesboro shooting, police say
news.summary: More than four months after a 17-year-old was gunned down in Jonesboro, Clayton County police have arrested two suspects in his death.

news.title: Clayton County Police arrest 2 suspects in connection with shooting that killed 17-year-old
news.summary: The department did not release the suspects' names.

news.title: ‘It’s just scary’: Phone threats lead to lockdowns at multiple metro Atlanta schools
news.summary: Police investigated multiple metro Atlanta schools for potential swatting pranks involving threats of rifles and explosives.

news.title: Yella Beezy verdict announced for Dallas capital murder trial
news.summary: The jury heard closing arguments on Tuesday, Nov. 10, and handed down their verdict after a hours of deliberation on Wednesday, Nov. 11.

news.title: Roswell man killed, survivor in Gwinnett plane crash identified
news.summary: A Roswell husband and father died Tuesday evening after a small plane suffered engine trouble and crashed into a wooded area near Lawrenceville.

news.title: Metro Atlanta company founder dies in small plane crash
news.summary: One man is dead and one is injured after a small plane crashed in Gwinnett County on Tuesday.

news.title: Pedestrian dies after crash on Roswell Road in Sandy Springs
news.summary: A deadly crash involving a vehicle and a pedestrian shut down part of Roswell Road in Sandy Springs on Wednesday.

news.title: Marist School lockdown lifted after threatening phone call
news.summary: A lockdown at Marist School in Brookhaven was lifted early Wednesday afternoon after police searched the campus and found no threats.

news.title: Two shooting scenes about a mile apart under investigation in Atlanta
news.summary: Authorities initially believed the two scene may have been connected; but in an update, they indicated they are unrelated at this time.
